[EN] Complacency has been the death of far too many archers. If you're focused on the shot, you're not focused on avoiding incoming fire. It's that basic.

Oh, and if you're looking for glyphs? Try the badge merchants and talent agents.
[ES] La complacencia ha sido la muerte de demasiados Archers. Si te concentras en el disparo, no te concentras en esquivar los ataques entrantes. Así de básico es.

Ah, ¿y si buscas glifos? Prueba con los comerciantes de insignias y agentes de talentos.
